api_db.title: API + Database
api_db.intro: Use Gmail API OAuth credentials stored in the database for the Google connection.

steps.title: Create OAuth app in Google Cloud
paragraphs: Enable Gmail API, configure consent screen, and create a Web OAuth client.

steps.title: Enter Client ID and Secret
paragraphs: Choose Database storage, paste Client ID and Client Secret, then verify credentials.

steps.title: Authorize and save tokens
paragraphs: Click Authorize and complete account consent to store refresh/access tokens.

steps.title: Publish the OAuth consent screen
paragraphs: Set Publishing status to In production in Google Cloud Console. Testing mode expires refresh tokens after 7 days.

api_wp_config.title: API + wp-config.php
api_wp_config.intro: Keep OAuth client credentials in constants and only store tokens in the app after authorization.

steps.title: Add constants from code snippet
paragraphs: Copy the generated constants and place them in wp-config.php.

steps.title: Use WP Config storage mode
paragraphs: Switch to WP Config mode and continue with verify + authorize flow.

steps.title: Publish the OAuth consent screen
paragraphs: Set Publishing status to In production in Google Cloud Console. Testing mode expires refresh tokens after 7 days.

smtp_db.title: SMTP + Database
smtp_db.intro: Use Google SMTP app password and endpoint settings stored in database.

steps.title: Generate app password
paragraphs: Enable 2FA in Google account and generate an app password.

steps.title: Enter SMTP details
paragraphs: Choose SMTP mode, keep endpoint preset, and provide username + app password. Sending 2,000+ emails/day on a Workspace account? Switch the endpoint preset to a Workspace Relay option (smtp-relay.gmail.com) instead -- it needs this server's IP allow-listed in the Workspace Admin console first (Apps > Google Workspace > Gmail > Routing > SMTP relay), but raises the daily ceiling well above the standard limit.

smtp_wp_config.title: SMTP + wp-config.php
smtp_wp_config.intro: Define SMTP credentials and presets via wp-config constants.

steps.title: Copy constants and add to wp-config.php
paragraphs: Use the generated constants block and save the file.

steps.title: Register connection
paragraphs: Keep storage in WP Config mode and save connection.
